description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from. 02.12.2024 to 08.12.2024.
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
